_meta.description: Pilot KPI catalogue + multi-framework mappings. Seeded once at first boot. Re-seeding upserts on `code` and replaces the mappings for each KPI; user-modified target/threshold/active values are PRESERVED (the seed only refreshes the immutable parts: names, descriptions, category, source).
